plan.notes: Source: official BMCC (CUNY) catalog program page https://bmcc.catalog.cuny.edu/programs/CSC-AS and the official CUNY Coursedog catalog PDF for the BMCC Computer Information Systems department (generated 2025-09-15, includes CSC-AS 'Computer Science Two Year Degree Map'), cross-checked with the official program page https://www.bmcc.cuny.edu/academics/departments/cis/computer-science/ (requirements + footnotes, effective 2025-2026 catalog year). Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official two-year degree map semester tables; course codes, titles, credits, and per-course prerequisites copied verbatim from the map. Caveats: (1) The official degree map sums to 63 credits while the degree requires 'earn at least 60 credits' with a 2.0 GPA and 15 credits in residence; (2) the two Flexible Core slots (Individual and Society; U.S. Experience in Its Diversity; World Cultures and Global Issues) may be any BMCC course approved for that Pathways area, with no more than two courses in any one discipline; (3) CSC 101 and CSC 111 satisfy the Flexible Core Scientific World requirement (program footnote 5) but are categorized as 'major' here since they are required program courses; (4) one Writing Intensive course is required to graduate; (5) SPE 100 is the program's advised Creative Expression choice (footnote 4); (6) MATH 206 vs MAT 301: footnote 1 requires one of them, the official map sequences both (MAT 206 -> MAT 301 -> MAT 302) as the calculus chain; (7) program-elective prerequisites vary by course (see choice notes).
